description: Runtime configuration for the accessibility-and-localization Skill Tool. Every value here is overridable with --config <file> (deep-merged) or per-run with --set for operation parameters.

locale.note: fil-PH, tl-PH and en-PH are treated as explicit, separate locale decisions, never as interchangeable labels.

paths.note: Leave paths empty to require an explicit --set/--reference per run; the tool never invents absolute paths.

product.name: Example product
product.note: Replace these values before generating statements, reports or register entries.

require_approval_for: writing generated bundles to a provided path
approvals.rule: Any operation that persists governance state, publishes a claim externally or deletes evidence requires --approve after human review.

providers.note: The Skill Tool ships no external service integrations. Add a local scanner command here only if your environment provides one; the tool will not call network endpoints by default.

severity_model.note: Scores combine impact, workaround availability, assistive-technology exclusivity and reach.

recommendations.governance: Publish the policy, name an accountable owner, and add an exception register with expiries.
recommendations.design: Add accessibility annotations to the design system and require them at design review.
recommendations.engineering: Make the linter and component contracts part of the pull-request gate.
recommendations.testing: Add keyboard and screen-reader scripts to the regression suite with pinned versions.
recommendations.content: Adopt plain-language targets, alt-text guidance and caption style rules.
recommendations.operations: Publish the intake and escalation matrix and track response service levels.
recommendations.localization: Externalise all strings, enforce terminology and run pseudolocalization in CI.
